params.body:
Shane, looking at the screen this morning: "ik vind de werking nog niet zo goed, de pagina is echt niet gebruiksvriendelijk", and then "ook geen volledige tabellen, dan blijf je scrollen".

## What it was

Seven cards with full tables under each other, some six hundred rows together, all weighing the same. The verdict at the top answers the only question the screen has, and then seven tables follow whether or not they have anything to say. On a good morning you scroll past seven tables that each say "nothing wrong", and the verdict stops meaning anything.

It was measurably outside the house style too, which is why it read as a different product:

| | |
| --- | --- |
| brand tokens | **1** (against 74 plain Tailwind greys) |
| `rounded-brand` | **0** (8 × `rounded-xl`) |
| `shadow-brand` | **0** |
| inline `style="…"` | **59** |

## The calm line was also lying

It called out **2.583 photos** "stuck in processing for more than an hour". `Operations::photos()` read `vehicle_photos` raw, and that table is soft-deleted: 273 of those rows had been thrown away long ago and **eleven** were really stuck. A calm line that cries wolf twice on the same morning is read once.

One `whereNull('deleted_at')`, and it is the most important line of this change.

## What it is now

One verdict, then per subject one line that carries the answer, with the detail in a `<details>` fold capped at five rows. No javascript, and a closed section stays findable with Ctrl-F.

**Integrations moved in.** "Is the Blurit key still there" is the same question as "does the clock run"; it sat as a separate tab under Settings for no reason other than having grown there.

**Activity moved out.** Who is online now is one line instead of 544 rows, and the partner API shows the five busiest dealers instead of twenty-five. That is busyness, not machine health, and it belongs on Analytics, the third screen in the split Shane made that day: Inzichten is strategic and looks back in months, Werking is operational and about now, Analytics is about how busy it is.

One thing went back in after the tests caught me: the **reason** on a partner refusal. Dropping it made the line shorter but R P3-15.3 requires it, and it is the part that turns "nederlandmobiel, wagen 18261, delete (HTTP 403)" into a message. What did go is the vehicle id and the verb, which were the parts you had to translate yourself.

## Pinned

`TheOperationsScreenIsScannableTest` holds the shape rather than the wording: no tables at all, no inline styles, brand tokens, every subject folded behind one line, the integrations present, and the activity as one line.

Verified locally: 46 tests, 186 assertions across the operations tests, the integration status tests and the rule-catalogue tests; `phpstan analyse` green on the whole project.
params.title: Werking is a screen you scan, not a log you scroll
